Build a pseudo-spectra MGF (dispatcher)

Source: R/api.R
carpediams.Rd

Picks process_xcms(), process_targetlist() or process_mzml() from input and targetlist, and passes everything else on.

Usage

carpediams(
  input,
  output,
  targetlist = NULL,
  tmp_dir = NULL,
  grouper = NULL,
  group_statistics_fn = NULL,
  filter_fn = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

input

Object or path; see Routing.

output

MGF path. Not needed for the "prepare", "sample" and "filter" stages.

targetlist

NULL, or a CSV path / data.frame with mz and rt columns.

tmp_dir

Working directory. NULL uses a tempfile() that is deleted when the call returns, so staged runs must pass a path.

grouper

A grouper closure; NULL uses the route default (ppm_upgma(ppm = 20) for xcms/target-list via their ppm argument, ppm_upgma(ppm = 30) for mzML).

group_statistics_fn

A statistics closure; NULL uses correlation_statistics(min_count = 10).

filter_fn

A filter closure; NULL uses correlation_filtering(cor_thresh = 0.1, fdr_thresh = 0.1).

...

Passed to the routed function (stage, ppm, top_n, …). process_mzml() takes no extra arguments.

Value

What the routed function returns: tmp_dir (invisibly) for the xcms and target-list routes, the pseudo-spectra table for mzML.

Routing

inputtargetlistRoute
XcmsExperiment/XCMSnExp, or .rds/.qs/.rda pathignored (warning)process_xcms()
mzML file, mzML directory, or vector of pathsgivenprocess_targetlist()
one mzML fileNULLprocess_mzml()
mzML directory or vector of pathsNULLerror

Pluggable steps

  • grouper (grouper-contract): ppm_upgma(), abs_upgma(), iaac_grouper(), pelt_grouper(), bin_grouper().

  • group_statistics_fn (stats-contract): correlation_statistics(), apex_correlation_statistics().

  • filter_fn (filter-contract): correlation_filtering(), apex_correlation_filtering() (needs apex_correlation_statistics()).

  • consensus_mz_fn (consensus-mz-contract): consensus_mz_weighted(). Pass it through ...; xcms and target-list routes only.

See also

Other api: process_mzml(), process_targetlist(), process_xcms()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# default — correlation-based filter
carpediams(input = "grouped.rds", output = "out.mgf")

# swap the grouper
carpediams(input = "grouped.rds", output = "out.mgf",
           grouper = iaac_grouper(k = 1, p0 = 8, Isat = 1e5))

# apex-agreement filter (needs the matching statistics)
carpediams(input = "grouped.rds", output = "out.mgf",
           group_statistics_fn = apex_correlation_statistics(),
           filter_fn           = apex_correlation_filtering(
                                   max_apex_shift_med = 0.5,
                                   max_apex_shift_iqr = 0.75))
} # }
